scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
What do you wan te withz me? Be gone!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你想干什么？滚开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
You have no more business with me, go away!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你跟我没什么好谈的了，走开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
E'llo mah frien, would I interesst tu with this rare mask? Its value I assure you is real mah frien. Tis manific!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你好啊朋友，对这稀有的面具感兴趣吗？我向你保证，它的价值可是货真价实的，朋友。真是精美绝伦！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ack! Forgez it! I can do bettaz en elsez where!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啧！算了吧！我在别处能做得比这更好！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Wah? O ho ho ho, so you know thaz I steal dis from those savages no? Well I won'tz give it back. But I will for a pricez... wat you say?
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
哇？哦呵呵呵，所以你知道这是我从那些野猪身上偷来的，对吧？哼，我可不会还回去。不过嘛，只要出个价……你觉得如何？

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ahh a business man are you no?  Fine, how about...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啊哈，你是个生意人，对吧？好吧，那么……

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Hmmm... you drive a hard bargain, ok... my final offer...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
嗯……你还真会讨价还价，好吧……这是我的最终报价……

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Are youz playin wit me? You don't have ze money!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你在耍我吗？你根本没那么多钱！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
O ho ho, it's a deal, then!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
哦呵呵，成交！
